method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Rates.title: United Kingdom CPI inflation climbs to 3.5% YoY in September, vs. 3.4% expected
Rates.summary: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 3.5% over the year in September, compared to a rise of 3.1% in August, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Hotter-than-expected UK CPI increases BOE tightening odds and market yields — negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance given immediate policy implications.

Rates.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
Rates.summary: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.
Rates.reason: Mainstream confirmation of stronger UK inflation that reinforces BOE hike expectations and upward pressure on sterling-area yields — negative for bonds, supports the FXStreet CPI item.

Rates.title: RBA's Hauser: Inflation outlook appears worse than forecast, slightly above expectations
Rates.summary: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said on Wednesday that he’s still finalizing forecasts and is uncertain about board decisions. Hauser added that the inflation outlook appears worse than forecast and slightly above expectations.
Rates.reason: RBA official flagging a worse-than-expected inflation outlook raises the probability of further tightening and pushes Australian yields higher — negative for bond prices in the region.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Himino says underlying inflation almost at 2% target
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Deputy Governor Ryozo Himino said on Wednesday that underlying inflation is almost at the 2% target, adding that financial conditions still accommodative.
Rates.reason: BoJ comments that underlying inflation is near target increase the chance of policy normalization (less ultra-accommodation), supporting higher JGB yields — modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: BoJ expected to hike in December, not in October – Reuters poll
Rates.summary: A Reuters poll revealed that a majority of economists expect the Bank of Japan to raise rates at its December meeting, marking the third increase since June.
Rates.reason: Market expectations for a December BoJ hike signal an ongoing global repricing of rates and supportive pressure on yields — negative for bond prices, though timing is a near-term offset to October.

Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026

Rates.title: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes

Rates.reason: Deteriorating housing data could argue for a Fed pause, but the piece frames it alongside the Fed 'weighing more hikes' — net effect is continued rate uncertainty with upward pressure on term yields as hikes remain on the table.

FX.reason: Regional sentiment data disappointing for the euro; modest negative signal for EUR/USD and adds to Europe-specific headwinds.
